App version, offline SQLite engine & target exams

What:
My Quiz v1.0.0 – A high-performance, offline-first study flashcard application with 3D Y-axis card flips, thread-safe SQLite persistence, and 100 pre-loaded quizzes across 10 core subjects.

Why:
Designed to empower candidates with high-speed spaced-repetition study flashcards and immediate self-assessment without requiring an internet connection.

Who will use:
Candidates and students preparing for Pakistan\'s standardized competitive exams & screening tests administered by:

🏛️ Federal & Provincial Civil Service Commissions:
• CSS (Central Superior Services – FPSC)
• PMS (Provincial Management Service – PPSC, SPSC, BPSC, KPPSC, AJKPSC, GBPSC)
• FPSC & PPSC General Recruitment Exams
• SPSC, KPPSC, BPSC, AJKPSC & GBPSC Competitive & General Exams

📝 National Testing & Assessment Agencies:
• NTS (NAT, GAT, & Departmental Recruitment Tests)
• HEC HAT (Higher Education Aptitude Test)
• ETC USAT & LAT (Law Admission Test)
• PTS, CTS, OTS & SIBA Testing Services (STS)

🏥 Medical & Technical Testing Bodies:
• PMDC MDCAT (Medical & Dental College Admission Test)
• NEB Exam (National Examination Board)
• ECAT (Engineering Colleges Admission Test)
